claims.claim: Kawasaki zzr power bike up for sales
claims.evidence: Witness report shows partial brand text on the tank (“Kawasa…”) and instrument/handlebar and wheel area, but no clear, readable “ZZR” model/variant identification.
Photos show instrument cluster area and wheel/brake rotor, but no evidence of the bike starting/running, no engine/ignition video, and no functional electricals shown.
This is a personal reason; the photos cannot confirm it.

risks.risk: Exact model/variant may not be ZZR (could be another Kawasaki model with similar tank branding). This affects parts availability and market value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full model badge/label (e.g., on tank/side fairing) and the VIN/engine number plate, plus a shot of the full instrument cluster showing model/indicator layout.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Kawasaki sport bike with unknown exact variant.

risks.risk: Not confirmed running/engine health (could have starting issues, overheating, oil leaks, or poor power).
risks.proof: Short video of a cold start and 2–3 minutes of idling, then a gentle throttle test; include a quick check of smoke color and engine sound.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: needs engine/service).

risks.risk: Mileage/odometer unknown; high mileage can reduce value and increase maintenance risk.
risks.proof: A close, readable photo of the odometer/trip meter on the instrument cluster.

risks.risk: Brake condition unknown beyond a single front wheel area; rear brake and pad/rotor wear could be poor.
risks.proof: Photos of both front and rear brake calipers/pads and both rotors (front and rear), plus a short clip showing brake lever/foot pedal feel.
risks.if_unproven: Price with brake service risk included (pads/rotors may need replacement).

risks.risk: Tyre condition unknown (only one wheel area is partially shown); tyres may be worn or unevenly worn.
risks.proof: Clear photos of both tyres (front and rear) showing tread and sidewall condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tyres may need replacement soon.

risks.risk: Electricals/charging system not verified (lights, indicators, horn, charging/charging warning).
risks.proof: Video showing ignition on with all lights/indicators/horn working; include a brief rev to see charging/neutral/engine warning behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electricals not fully verified (possible minor-to-major fixes).

risks.risk: Body/frame condition and accident damage not fully shown; hidden damage can affect safety and resale.
risks.proof: Full side photos (left and right) and a close-up of frame/engine mounting points, plus under-fairing/footrest areas.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming average wear with possible hidden repairs.

risks.risk: Documents/ownership status unknown; Abuja buyers are exposed to theft/transfer issues if papers are missing or mismatched.
risks.proof: Photos of ownership documents (receipt/contract), VIN/engine number matching, and any transfer/registration papers available.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for documentation risk (treat as papers not confirmed).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the full model/variant name (confirm “ZZR” or exact variant) on tank/side fairing and/or any badge.
Cold-start video (start from off), then 2–3 minutes idling and a gentle throttle test.
Photos of both tyres (front and rear) showing tread depth and sidewall condition.
Photos of front and rear brakes: pads/calipers and both rotors (front + rear).
Video of electricals: headlamp, indicators, brake light, horn; include ignition-on dashboard warning lights behavior.
Photos of frame/body condition: left and right full sides, and close-ups of frame/engine mounting points.
Documents/ownership proof: receipt/contract and any registration/transfer papers; VIN/engine number plate photos.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a Kawasaki motorcycle from visible tank text and instrument/wheel areas, so it can be priced at its worst-case within that category. However, running condition, exact ZZR variant, mileage, tyres, brakes, electricals, and documents are not verified by the photos, so the price should reflect those uncertainties.
